segments.text: Ever wished you could run Linux containers on your Mac without the slowdowns or hacks? Container makes it happen. Super lightweight, blazing fast, and fully optimized for Apple silicon.
It handles OCI compatible images so you can pull, run, and push containers anywhere. Built on the containerization Swift package, it manages everything
under the hood, containers, images, processes effortlessly. One tool, native speed, perfect for testing, development,
